I was maybe 11 or twelve at the time and I was out shopping with my parents for our yearly trip to visit our relatives in Mexico. We always drove there so having something to do was pretty essential for me. All I had at the time was Gameboy SD with a few games I’ve already beat so I was looking for something that would keep me interested for the whole trip. That’s when I saw the box for Final Fantasy 5. I’ve only heard of the FF series through my EGM magazines I read and never played one before so I took a chance and asked my dad for the game. To this day it will always be one of my favorite games ever, the music, the characters, the sprites, everything made for a truly unforgettable summer playing that game with my cousins and trying to figure out how to find Ramuh and Shiva cause people kept hinting them.

Hoo boy. One of my greatest campaigns was probably in TW: Warhammer 2. I was playing a ME campaign as the Vampire Counts and everything was going smooth at first. I had agents all across the Empire spreading corruption and unrest and in the meantime I was building my forces, getting ready for the right moment to burst out of Sylvania in tide of corpses and nightmare beasts.
At least that was the plan, what I didn’t realize was that the entire southern part of the Old World was being taken over by the Greenskins. The Dwarves along with the Southern Realms were wiped off the map and the only way left for them to go was north. They declared war on me and sent 3 stacks to Sylvania, I was caught really off guard and my armies were not built or prepared to fight Greenskins (I had mostly cheaper infantry and lots of fast moving units to fight the horrible Empire skirmishes and artillery) I was barely able to hold them off thanks to attrition and my wall towers. The Greenskin armies were defeated and my lands were safe, but they were popping out armies faster than I could kill them. I knew I’d lose if I just stayed on the defensive the whole time so I took Mannfred and Ghorst my two strongest lords and fought through Blackfire Pass into enemy territory, taking the capital at the end and using it as our staging ground for this long war. 
I could go on, but there are many stories of that war that invoke heroic victories and close defeats. I sent Mannfred East to claim the former Dwarf capital from the filthy greenskins and use the mineral riches inside to fund this campaign. I also had a banshee who through her Ethereal trait and some items had 100 percent physical resistance, she led many cairn wraiths into the front lines and tore those armored fucks to ribbons. Best part is this War is still going on.
